system.description: You pour salt over a pile of bones or an empty suit of armour.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it works until the end of the next day.
outcomes.success: It rises as a mindless servant for 8 hours. It cannot fight, but it can carry gear, dig, or do repetitive work without tiring. It is a Pitiful minion and counts toward your minion limit.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the salt and time are lost.
outcomes.ruin: It rises, works for an hour, then wanders off into the dark with your gear. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
